# PitlaneStats

> The most comprehensive Formula 1 statistics database on the web.

PitlaneStats covers the complete history of Formula 1 from 1950 to the present, including every driver, constructor, race, circuit, and season.

## Sections

- [Seasons](https://pitlanestats.com/seasons/index.html): Championship seasons from 1950 to the present, including race calendars, standings, and results
- [Drivers](https://pitlanestats.com/drivers/index.html): Career profiles for every F1 driver, including wins, podiums, poles, and championship results
- [Teams](https://pitlanestats.com/constructors/index.html): Constructor profiles with championship history and race results
- [Circuits](https://pitlanestats.com/circuits/index.html): Track information for every Grand Prix venue
- [Records](https://pitlanestats.com/records/index.html): All-time F1 leaderboards — wins, poles, podiums, championships, and more
- [Head-to-Head](https://pitlanestats.com/head-to-head/index.html): Teammate and rivalry comparisons across qualifying and race results
- [Wet Weather Stats](https://pitlanestats.com/wet-weather/index.html): Rain race statistics, wet-weather specialists, and the most dramatic rain races in F1 history
- [Points System History](https://pitlanestats.com/points-history/index.html): The complete history of the F1 points system from 1950 to the present
- [Calendar](https://pitlanestats.com/calendar/index.html): Current F1 season schedule with race dates and circuits
- [On This Day](https://pitlanestats.com/on-this-day/index.html): What happened on every day of the year in F1 history
- [Sitemap](https://pitlanestats.com/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap

## Notes

- This is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages
- Data sourced from the Jolpica F1 API (Ergast compatible)
- Not affiliated with Formula 1, FIA, or any team
- Data is factual and statistical in nature
